title: Cookbook: edge cases and migration lab for interactive charts & data tables
creator: Aisha Morales
description:
Goal: create a focused cookbook and interactive "lab" page in the docs site that documents common and unusual usage patterns for charts and data tables, documents token migrations that affect these components, and provides runnable migration recipes and anti-pattern guidance. Scope includes: token mapping (color/spacing/typography), button interactions inside tables, pagination/sorting edge-cases, chart legend & tooltip accessibility states, and step-by-step migration recipes from legacy tokens to new semantic tokens.

Non-goals: writing new component code or changing runtime behavior; large-scale rebrand content outside tokens; exhaustive API reference (we will link to API docs).

Deliverables (high level):
- A cookbook page per component (Charts, DataTable, TableRow Actions) with 6-8 illustrative examples (good, acceptable, do-not).
- Migration lab: runnable examples (Storybook/CodeSandbox links) showing before/after token swaps and common fixes when spacing or color shifts break layout.
- Accessibility checklist and automated test snippets for each example (axe + keyboard tests).
- Short migration checklist for platform teams and an ops note for Dedicated/private customers on rollout impact.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Each cookbook page has at least 6 examples with live artifacts (Storybook/CodeSandbox).
2) Migration lab includes 3 mapping tables: color, spacing, typography (with example diffs).
3) Docs have clear do/don't callouts and a developer cheat-sheet for quick fixes.
4) Peer review from ENG and PM completed and PR merged to docs repo.

Success metrics:
- < 10 support tickets related to token migration in first month after release.
- 75% of early reviewers rate examples as 'directly actionable' in internal survey.
